note: Rival activity, rumours and race (Story Overhaul W4, design 14.11 to 14.13, 14.23). Update templates and race lines are text; the rules are in core/rivals/activity.ts. Rumour payoffs are tags for later slices (W8/W2); only 'training', 'injured', 'badge', 'recruitment', 'evolution', 'rivalVsRival' and 'friendEdge' change rival state today.

templates: A traveler says {rival} took the mountain road.
{rival} got beat down. They're training now.
{rival} is resting at a Pokémon Center.
{rival} healed up and set out again.
{rival} has a new Pokémon, but won't say what.
{ace} looked stronger the last time we saw it.
{rival}'s name is on the Champion board.
{rival} was last seen heading to a cave.
Nobody has heard from {rival} in days.

{rival} stopped at a flower stall, and left a note.
{rival} sat alone, staring at an old photo.

{rival} lost three in a row and quit the road.

There's a hidden cave behind the waterfall.

The {gym} leader asked about you.
{rival} caught a rare {species}.
{rival} and {other} are feuding.

rumors.correction: The Champion never left the League. That story was wrong.

rumors.text: A merchant is selling a treasure map.
A rift opened near {place}.
{rival}'s ace evolved.
The Elite Four are looking for challengers.
Someone is giving away eggs at the festival.
{rival} found a lost civilization.
rumors.correction: No lost civilization. {rival} found an old map stall.

rumors.text: A trainer is looking for you by name.
The old lab has lights on at night.
{rival} is hurt and hiding.
A tournament will be held next week.
A sanctuary healed a whole team here.
{rival} beat the whole Elite Four!
rumors.correction: {rival} is only a Champion candidate. The Elite Four story was wrong.

rumors.text: The sea is rough. Strange sounds from below.
{other} is secretly {rival}'s friend.

ahead: I'm already a step in front. Try to catch up.
Fast is the only way I know to travel.
Check the scoreboard. I'm winning.
behind: You're ahead for now. Enjoy it.
I'll make the time back by the next gym.
Second place is just first place on loan.
even: Dead even. I like it.
We keep landing on the same step. Fine by me.
One badge decides this. Make it count.
champion: The seat is mine. Come take it.
I climbed the whole ladder first.
Champion. Say it out loud for me.

ahead: Naturally, I'm ahead. Don't take it personally.
You can watch my back from there.
Everyone's behind me. You're just closest.
behind: Your lead is a rounding error.
I let you have that gym. Generous of me.
Enjoy the view. It won't last.
even: Even? That can't last. I'll fix it.
Side by side. For now.
We're level, which flatters you.
champion: Of course I'm Champion. Who else?
The crown fits better than I imagined.
Bow, or battle. Your pick.

ahead: Hey, I got a bit ahead! Catch up soon, okay?
I saved you a spot on the road ahead!
I'm in front, but I'll wait if you need me.
behind: You're so far ahead! I'm cheering for you.
I'm a bit behind. You inspire me.
Go on without me. I'll be right there!
even: We're even! That's the best kind of race.
Look at us, side by side!
We keep running into each other. I love it.
champion: I'm Champion! Can you believe it?
I won, and I still want to battle you.
The seat is warm. Come sit with me!

ahead: I am ahead. That is the only fact that matters.
Every stop I clear is one you can't.
You're a step behind. I plan to keep it so.
behind: You are ahead. I am noting how.
A lead can be removed.
I will take what you took, and more.
even: Even. I will correct that.
We stand level. One of us will not.
An equal is an obstacle.
champion: The title is mine. I earned it.
I'm Champion. Everything else was practice.
Reach the top and find me waiting.

ahead: ...I passed through before you.
The road remembers me. It will remember you later.
You will find my footprints there.
behind: You walk faster than I thought.
I fell behind. I wasn't listening to the road.
...Impressive. Go ahead.
even: We keep arriving together. Odd.
Not ahead, not behind. Interesting.
The road put us here for a reason.
champion: The seat feels... quiet.
I wear the title like a coat. It doesn't warm me.
Come. I'll show you what is at the top.

ahead: By my estimate, I lead by one stop.
My route was more efficient. Data supports it.
You're behind, but the margin is small.
behind: You lead. I'm adjusting my model.
I mispredicted your pace. Won't happen twice.
Behind, but my notes are thicker.
even: Statistically, we're tied.
Level. A fascinating sample.
Our paths converge. I expected that.
champion: The seat confirms my hypothesis.
I am Champion. The method works.
Come test the conclusion.

ahead: Wait, I'm ahead? That can't be right.
I got further than I thought... don't look at me like that.
I'm in front, but you'll pass me soon.
behind: I knew you'd be ahead. You always are.
I'm behind again. I'm used to it.
Please don't wait for me.
even: We're even? Really? Okay...
I can't believe I kept up.
Together at the same stop. That means something, right?
champion: I'm Champion?! Somebody check that.
I won. I actually won.
Don't treat me differently. Treat me like before.

ahead: I'm ahead, but I'm hoping you catch up.
I reached the next town first. The people were kind.
A lead means more people to help.
behind: You lead the way. I'll follow with a clear heart.
Behind doesn't mean lost.
I stopped to help someone. Worth it.
even: Together again. It feels like fate.
Even steps, even hearts.
We're walking the same road.
champion: I'm Champion, so I can finally change things.
The seat carries a promise, and I'll keep it.
Come, let's show them what a Champion can be.

ahead: Ha! Took a shortcut. Of course I'm ahead!
I jumped a fence or two. Worth it!
Catch me if you can!
behind: You're ahead? Not for long!
I got lost. Great scenery though.
I'll sprint the rest. Watch me!
even: Even! Let's break the tie loudly.
Same spot again? Let's fight!
We're tied. Chaos is fun!
champion: Champion! Didn't see that coming either!
I beat the lot. No plan needed!
Let's celebrate with a battle!

ahead: Oh, am I ahead? How careless of you.
I made friends along the way. They helped.
You're behind, sweetheart. It happens.
behind: Enjoy the lead. I like being underestimated.
You're ahead. Whose idea was that, I wonder?
Behind? I'm exactly where I want to be.
even: Level. How convenient for me.
We're tied. Shall we make it interesting?
Same spot. Almost like I planned it.
champion: Champion. Funny how things work out.
I smiled and the seat was mine.
Come visit. I'll set a place for you.

ahead: I am ahead. The pace is steady.
I do not hurry. I arrive.
The lead is a fact, not a boast.
behind: You are ahead. Good.
I am behind. I will correct course.
A longer road teaches more.
even: We are even. As expected.
Level. Neither of us has stumbled.
Same stop. Same goal.
champion: I hold the seat. It is heavy.
Champion. The duty is real.
If you want it, earn it.

ahead: I'm ahead. I counted every step.
I cleared the gym three times to be sure.
I know exactly how far ahead I am.
behind: You're ahead. I've written down how.
I'm behind. I'll fix it. I'll fix it.
I'll study your route until I understand it.
even: We're tied. I've been tracking it.
Even. That is not acceptable.
Same step. I need one more.
champion: I'm Champion. I checked the board twice.
Every trophy is catalogued. This is the best.
The seat is mine. Don't touch the record.
